messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for continuous-batching path in region:usw2 — SLO breach (>3x baseline). paging oncall-alex :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: on it. linking dashboard + traces pls — what are customers seeing?
sre-jamie: seeing p95 ~450ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~1.8s -> 6.5s over the last 12m. streaming stalls count up 4x.
runtime-lee: noticed packer queues show a small number of very large batches (≥120k tokens) mixing with many tiny ones. packer metrics: avg_batch_tokens upward spike, tail padding skyrocketed.
eng-maya: that sounds like mixed-seqlen amplification — long sequences hold batch for pack window and short ones get padded -> tail blowup. any KV evictions?
sre-jamie: kv_cache_evictions spiked on the same hosts — eviction churn likely from long-lived KV entries for the long sequences. logs attached: `batcher:pack_window=30ms, avg_pack_wait=28ms, max_batch_tokens=122880`
eng-maya: yikes. Two likely levers: reduce pack_window or lower max_batch_tokens on hot pool, OR enable preemptive-shedding for very long requests.
support-zoe: support queue — two customers reported elevated latency and one reported partial streaming responses (client-side timeouts). affected customers flagged: tenant-42, tenant-omega, tenant-alpha (low volume). Pass along SLAs?
pm-sam: notify-account? Tier-1 customers only; put triage note in status page draft.
oncall-alex: quick plan for live mitigation: 1) temporarily reduce `batcher.pack_window_ms` from 30 -> 10 on pool-usw2-hot 2) set `batcher.max_batch_tokens` 122880 -> 40960 as emergency 3) flip `scheduler.seqlen_fairness_override=high` to prioritize short sequences 4) route streaming traffic for tenant-omega to backup pool (route:streaming-backup-usw2)
runtime-lee: can do 1+2 via runtime config API, rolling across 6 batcher pods. will start now and report.
eng-maya: also add `pack_shed_threshold=0.7` to shed large packs if padding ratio >70% — avoids extreme pad amplification.
sre-jamie: I'll open temporary shed rule: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/configs/batcher -d '{"pack_window_ms":10, "max_batch_tokens":40960, "pack_shed_threshold":0.7}'`

incident-bot: ops action started by runtime-lee — runbook: contbatch-mitigation v1.2 invoked.
runtime-lee: rolling change started: patch applied to pod batcher-1 in zone A. monitoring metrics.
[some minutes pass]
runtime-lee: batcher-1/2/3 patched. initial signal: p99 dropped from 6.5s -> 3.1s, p95 -> 700ms. streaming stalls decreased by ~40%.
sre-jamie: good. still above SLO but trending. traffic skewed — one pod (batcher-5) still shows high pad ratio, isolating now.
oncall-alex: isolating batcher-5 from hot pool and marking for debug. routing removed.
support-zoe: customer reports reduced timeouts for tenant-alpha, tenant-42 still sees intermittent stalls.
eng-maya: propose a second mitigation: enable preemptive trimming of large requests at scheduler level for streaming path (limit active long sequences to 2 concurrent per-core). helps fairness for short seqs.
sre-jamie: we can toggle `scheduler.max_concurrent_long=2` on hot pool. ready to apply if runtime-lee approves.
runtime-lee: approve, applying now.
[some minutes pass]
runtime-lee: applied `max_concurrent_long=2`. p99 now ~1.6s, p95 ~420ms — under SLO for most traffic. streaming stalls back to baseline.
pm-sam: great — draft to status page: "Partial impact to a small number of customers in usw2 due to continuous-batching packing amplification; mitigations applied; monitoring and postmortem underway."
support-zoe: adding affected customers to follow-up list and reaching out with ETA.
oncall-alex: handoff notes for next on-call (sre-jamie): 1) mitigation commands used 2) pods isolated 3) need deeper postmortem on why pack_window and max_batch_tokens were not adaptive to seqlen distribution 4) collect flamegraphs for batcher-5 and KV eviction traces 5) follow-up with model infra about sequences that cause huge token counts
sre-jamie: taking handoff. I'll keep watch for 2h and gather traces. planning root-cause tasks: `- eval seqlen distribution by tenant` `- add automated packer knob: adaptive pack_window based on pad_ratio` `- add alert for pad_ratio > 0.5`
eng-maya: add evaluation: run synthetic mixed-seqlen load against packer variants (pack_window_ms=5/10/20) and measure p99 & cost delta. also check quantization impact on execution time for long sequences.
pm-sam: request postmortem and customer comms draft by EOD.
support-zoe: confirming outreach: tenant-42 and tenant-omega contacted, status page updated.
oncall-alex: final: no ongoing page, set pager_status=watch, will re-escalate if p99 > 2s again. good job team :thumbsup:
sre-jamie: noted. adding follow-ups to backlog and scheduling a postmortem meeting tomorrow.
eng-maya: small note — we should consider separate streaming batch pool for tiny-seq-heavy tenants to avoid future contention.
pm-sam: assigned to product backlog as "seqmix isolation".
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated — SLOs restored to within threshold. auto-closing alert in 15m unless regress.
last message: oncall-alex: leaving detailed runbook snippet here for next ops: ```
# quick mitigation commands
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/configs/batcher -d '{"pack_window_ms":10, "max_batch_tokens":40960, "pack_shed_threshold":0.7}'
# isolate pod
kubectl label pod batcher-5 node-role.kubernetes.io/isolated=true
# toggle scheduler fair share
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/configs/scheduler -d '{"max_concurrent_long":2, "seqlen_fairness_override":"high"}'
```

oncall-alex: handing off to sre-jamie for watch and postmortem collection.
